description: CR 109.5 an opponent's spell naming ANOTHER player fires nothing
note: Amulet of Safekeeping: "Whenever you become the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {1}." The recipient, moved on its own: bob's Lightning Bolt names carol, one seat over from the Amulet's controller alice. CR 109.5's "you" is alice, and carol is neither her nor the caster, so only the Bolt goes on the stack, nobody is offered the {1} (an offer would be an unscheduled prompt) and the Bolt resolves onto carol. Three seats, so the target is neither the Amulet's controller nor the caster.
